name: WebBrowserInstance
label: Web Browser Instance
description: Enter or choose the variable that contains the web browser instance to work with.

name: FindType
label: Find Type
description: Specifies how to find the element (e.g., ID, XPath, CssSelector).

name: SearchKeywords
label: Search Keywords
description: The value used to locate the element (e.g., 'username', '//input[@id='email']').

name: StateToCheck
label: State To Check
description: Specifies which state to verify: Visible, Enabled, Selected.

selectOptions.label: Visible
selectOptions.description: Checks if the element is displayed on the page.

selectOptions.label: Enabled
selectOptions.description: Checks if the element is enabled (clickable/interactable).

selectOptions.label: Selected
selectOptions.description: Checks if the element is selected (e.g., checkbox/radio button).

name: WaitForElement
label: Wait For Element
description: If true, waits for the element to appear before checking its state.

name: TimeoutSeconds
label: Timeout Seconds
description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the element before failing.

name: IsStateMet
label: Is State Met
description: Returns true if the element meets the specified state condition.
